references.text: Satan tempts Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden, which mirrors how the devil tempts Jesus in the wilderness.
God will command his angels to guard you, a reference that the devil later uses in his temptation of Jesus.
The prophecy about Immanuel, pointing to Jesus as God's Son, which the devil challenges by saying, 'If you are the Son of God'.
Jesus was tempted in every way, just as we are, yet without sin, including the event in the wilderness.
